observations.seen: Lighting is inconsistent across venues. The Moon frame has one hard key over a black void with no fill, so the stands fall into near-black. The Dubai frame is flat and washed out with almost no key/fill contrast. Only the Paris frame has a deliberate warm low key. None of the frames reads as a 55°/45° arena flood rig.

Player and net shadows are crisp and directional in the Moon and Paris frames, and the net shadow lands correctly on the clay. In the blue-court frame, shadows are faint, and the stands cast soft, smeared blocks onto the floor.

The 'THE MOON 0-0 0-0' and 'WORLD TOUR' signage is mirrored onto the court surface as a ghostly planar reflection, even on the matte clay in Paris. Nothing else shows environment reflection or specular response.

There are three venues: the Moon, Paris with a lattice-tower prop, and Dubai. Each is a large empty single-color floor plane around the court, with blurred cardboard-like background structures and bare light poles. The arena feels unfinished outside the stands.
There is no indoor haze or light shafts. Dubai has only a global low-contrast wash. The Moon background is a black void with a flat sphere.

Surfaces are flat colors. The blue court has a faint diagonal stripe texture in the first frame. Clay, grass-green surround, and sand floors look like uniform plastic with no roughness variation, wear, or line paint texture.
Players and crowd are chunky low-poly figures, and the crowd is cloned in identical rows. The umpire chair and bench are plain boxes. The net is a thin line with no mesh detail.

In the first frame the court fills about 65% of the frame, above the 25–40% target. In the other frames the court sits at about 35%, but the lower third is empty floor. The far player's head occludes the 'AURA SLAM' banner, leaving it reading 'AURA SL M'.

The camera uses an elevated perspective broadcast angle with a centered, symmetric court. The first frame is close to top-down, so the angle varies between shots, and the projection is perspective rather than orthographic.
The first frame has a vignette and a soft bloom hotspot at the right edge. Background props get a depth-of-field blur. Dubai is grey and low-contrast. There is no consistent arena grade.

There is no screen-space HUD. The score appears only as small in-world text on the back wall. The target service box is a flat unlit pale-yellow overlay with a pink ring, and it clashes with the scene lighting.
